# v0.3.34 — Fix tool permissions and Auto review routing

## What's changed

- Custom permissions now reach new and reused topic sessions. Changing permissions in main chat also updates its active background work before subsequent tool calls. Switching away from Auto no longer leaves an old topic in Auto.
- Auto review requests from TheOne topics and their runtime-owned child tasks carry the executing session's identity, fixing missing-session routing failures with providers such as OpenCode Go.
- Main chat displays the background tool's actual reviewed result instead of reviewing the same call twice. This also works when Auto is enabled or reloaded during a response.
- Topic classification, history indexing, summaries and fact extraction include source-session routing metadata. The metadata stays outside the model-visible prompt.

Approval rejection, failed reviews and cancellation continue to prevent execution. Permission changes affect subsequent calls; they do not retroactively terminate commands already running. The Auto compatibility fix is scoped to TheOne and its child tasks; unrelated native DSH sessions remain under the host's behavior.

Validation covers real DSH services with deterministic models, nested tasks, concurrent-session isolation, permission reductions and plugin reloads. The installed OpenCode transport was also checked against a local HTTP endpoint; no live OpenCode account was used.

## 中文

- 修复自定义权限未传到话题的问题。主聊天中途修改权限，会同步到正在运行的后台话题；退出 Auto 后，旧话题不再残留 Auto 状态。
- 修复 TheOne 话题及其子任务的自动审查请求缺少会话 ID，导致 OpenCode Go 等服务报 `MissingSessionID` 的问题。
- 修复后台工具已执行、主聊天却重复审查并报 schema 错误的问题；回复过程中启用或重载 Auto 也能正确处理。
- 为话题分类、历史索引、摘要和事实提取补齐来源会话标识，仅作为请求元数据传递，不混进正文。

审批拒绝、审查失败和取消仍会阻止执行。权限变更约束后续调用，不会追溯终止已启动的命令。Auto 兼容修复覆盖 TheOne 及其子任务，普通 DSH 会话仍遵循宿主行为。

验证使用真实 DSH 服务和可控模型，覆盖多层子任务、并发会话隔离、权限收紧和插件重载；另用已安装的 OpenCode 请求组件对本地 HTTP 服务验证了请求头，未调用真实 OpenCode 账号。
